description: METACOD GLP-1 Complication Prevention — molecular drug profile database v2. Expanded from v1 (21 profiles) to 60 profiles covering: thyroid, iron, anticoagulants, loop diuretics, PPIs, antibiotics, antifungals, TKI/oncology, CDK4/6 inhibitors, psychotropics, anticonvulsants, immunosuppressants, additional cardio, antidiabetics, additional pH and cation perpetrators. Schema unchanged from v1 (additive only).

field_definitions.requires_acidic_pH: Sensitivity of dissolution / solubility to elevated gastric pH (PPI/H2RA). Enum: none|low|moderate|high
field_definitions.proximal_absorption_critical: Absorption window confined to proximal small bowel
field_definitions.bile_dependent: Requires bile acids for micellar solubilization (lipophilic)
field_definitions.high_first_pass: Significant first-pass hepatic extraction; cirrhosis raises bioavailability
field_definitions.inflammation_sensitive_clearance: CYP substrate clearance falls during systemic inflammation (cytokine CYP suppression)
field_definitions.protein_binding: Enum: low|moderate|high. High binding + low albumin = misleading total levels
field_definitions.narrow_therapeutic_index: Small PK shifts produce clinical events
field_definitions.tmax_sensitive: Clinical effect depends on rapid peak (delayed gastric emptying matters)
field_definitions.modified_release: ER/MR/enteric/SR — vulnerable after altered GI anatomy
field_definitions.gut_edema_sensitive: Oral bioavailability falls in HF congestion / gut edema
field_definitions.is_perpetrator_cation: This drug binds others as a multivalent cation source
field_definitions.qt_prolongation_risk: Risk of QT prolongation; combinations require ECG monitoring
